title: Crew style + animation reference: chibi field medic

pixellab.view: low top-down rotations; the side view (east) is the one used

concept.how: create_image_pixflux 48x48, init = earlier chibi medic side sprite at strength 70, forced master palette, seed 22, direction south
concept.prompt: chibi survivor medic, front view facing the viewer, full body standing, very big head, messy spiky black hair, white coat with red cross armband, blue jeans, dark shoes, thick black outline, 16-bit pixel art

character_prompt: chibi survivor field medic, big head, messy spiky black hair falling over the eyes, long grubby cream-white coat open over a dark grey shirt, red cross patch on the arm, dark grey trousers, worn boots, muted desaturated grey tones, thick black outline, dark post-apocalyptic 16-bit pixel art

palette.production_rule: snap every frame to tools/art/common.py PALETTE with tools/art/pixelize.py nearest(); see previews/palette-snap-check.png

work.source: v3: hammer raised and struck down in front onto a workbench

sit.source: v3: lowers into a seated pose, stays seated

chuuni_pose.source: v3: flips the coat open, hand over one eye, smug lean back

talk.source: v3: chatting, head nods, one hand gestures

eat.source: v3: bowl at chest height, spoon to mouth, chewing

drink.source: v3: canteen raised, head tilted back, wipes mouth

activity_guitar.source: v3: strums an acoustic guitar, head bobbing

cast.method: edit_image_pro_flash, method text, image = approved/rotations/east.png, no_background, seed 1, 5 generations each; use_color_palette_correction true unless the character needs an accent colour the medic lacks (then false and say the colour explicitly)

back_foot.how: copy the bottom leg rows whose opaque width is <= 8 px (truck_driver: last 6 rows at <= 9 px), shift them +3 x and -1 y, darken non-outline pixels to 60 %, composite behind the figure, so a back foot shows like the medic's angled stance

postprocess.punk_musician: shin rows 38-39 removed (legs were 2 px too long), then the back foot
postprocess.feet_row: every figure ends on row 42 like the medic; old_fisherman, street_cook and lounge_singer moved up 1 px
postprocess.long_skirts: lounge_singer and fortune_teller wear floor-length skirts, so no back foot is added

cast_animations.how: create_character mode pro, concept_image_url = approved/cast/<name>.png, size 48 (10 generations each); then animate_character mode v3, directions [east], frame_count 8 (1 generation each). Frame 0 is the reference pose; canvases 52-60 px.

walk.action_description: walking forward at a steady pace, legs stepping and arms swinging, loop

eat.action_description: eating: holding a small bowl in one hand at chest height and scooping food to the mouth with a spoon, chewing, repeating loop

drink.action_description: drinking: raising a metal water canteen to the mouth, tilting the head back to drink, then lowering it and wiping the mouth

work.action_description: working: holding a hammer in the front hand, raising it and striking down in front of the body onto a workbench, repeating loop

talk.action_description: talking: standing and chatting, mouth opening and closing, head nodding, one hand gesturing while explaining, loop

idle.action_description: idle breathing loop, standing relaxed, chest rising and falling gently, slight head bob, blinks once

aviator_pilot.signature: adjusting the goggles on her flying cap, then giving a confident two-finger salute

biker.signature: flipping her long hair back over the shoulder, then cracking her knuckles with a cocky smirk

bus_mechanic.signature: wiping greasy hands on a rag, then spinning a wrench in one hand

construction_worker.signature: resting a sledgehammer on her shoulder, then wiping sweat from her forehead with the back of her hand

firefighter.signature: heaving the fire axe up onto his shoulder, then flexing his free arm proudly

fortune_teller.signature: shuffling a deck of tarot cards, then fanning them out mysteriously with a sly look

gunslinger.signature: twirling a revolver around her finger, then sliding it smoothly into the hip holster

hunter.signature: drawing the recurve bow, pulling the arrow back to aim forward, holding steady, then lowering the bow

lounge_singer.signature: singing into an old microphone, swaying her hips gently, free hand making a graceful flourish

monk.signature: bringing both palms together in front of the chest and bowing slowly in a respectful wai greeting, then straightening up calmly

motorbike_courier.signature: checking her wristwatch impatiently and tapping one foot, then glancing ahead

office_worker.signature: pushing his cracked glasses up his nose, checking the battered briefcase, then letting out a tired sigh with slumped shoulders

old_fisherman.signature: casting the fishing rod forward with a flick, then holding it patiently and waiting for a bite

old_seamstress.signature: sewing with a needle and thread, pulling the thread up and through cloth, peering closely through her glasses

plant_grower.signature: tilting a watering can forward and watering plants on the ground, then straightening up happily

police_officer.signature: lifting the radio from her belt and talking into it, then pointing forward with authority

punk_musician.signature: headbanging wildly and strumming an air guitar with big energetic arm swings

retired_teacher.signature: leaning on his cane, lifting a finger and wagging it as if giving a lecture, nodding wisely

scientist.signature: shaking the glowing green test tube, holding it up to the light and examining it closely with curiosity

soldier.signature: snapping to attention with heels together and giving a crisp military salute, then lowering the hand

street_cook.signature: tossing food in a frying pan with a flick of the wrist, catching it, then wiping hands on the towel over his shoulder

teen_scrap_runner.signature: pulling back a slingshot, aiming forward and letting the stone fly, then grinning

teen_tinkerer.signature: tinkering with a small gadget in both hands using a screwdriver, a few tiny sparks pop, he flinches then grins

truck_driver.signature: stretching his back with both hands on the lower back, arching backwards and yawning widely, then scratching his belly

cast_animations.notes: work: some characters gained a small anvil or bench at their feet (pilot, gunslinger, hunter, lounge singer, fortune teller) and a few wind up behind the head; reviewed and kept.
cast_animations.west: left-facing = horizontal mirror of every east clip (Sprite2D.flip_h); not stored

cast_portraits.how: create_portrait_character (character_to_portrait, low top-down, 64 px, seed 1, ~15 generations) from the character south rotation, then edit_image_pro_flash (5 generations): "Same person ... turned to a three-quarter view facing right, <personal expression>; muted desaturated colours, dark gritty post-apocalyptic mood, soft warm lamp light from the side", then snapped to the master palette with pixelize.nearest().
cast_portraits.notes: teen_scrap_runner came back with a red beanie instead of the bandana; the punk pink turns salmon in the palette snap.

restyled_from_reference.how: edit_image_pro_flash on the teen_scrap_runner portrait itself: "Turn this portrait into a different person while keeping exactly the same art style, pixel size, head size, framing, three-quarter angle, shading and muted palette: <person>", then snapped. Use this for every new portrait so head size and cartoon style match.
